provides: At a zero-free-coordinate leaf of E0C’s fixed finite hierarchy, the actual finite-control component has fixed-network size S and bounded populations. Its unnormalized weights are exact rationals a_x V^(sum_i x_i), with fixed a_x=c^x/x!. Their heights, the finite sum normalizer and exact probabilities have O_Theta(1+log V) bits. Round probabilities down on a grid of denominator 2^m, assign the residual to one state, and sample with exactly m fair bits, choosing a nonnegative integer m>=ceil(log2(S/epsilon))+1.
